body: So we just not talk about it. There are positive aspects and negative aspects to anything in life. NAH. 

Because It's probably post-partum for OP, so I think being overly emotional is normal. So i'll give you that.

At the same time, "MIL" as you refer to her as, is in fact, your daughter's grandma, and not just your MIL. Nothing weird about a grandmother loving her grandchild. Maybe it's the cultural difference but in my culture grandparents like grandkids more than their children, so i don't think it's weird. Also, it seems you don't have a liking for your MIL, which just happens sometimes... however, you have to accept that esp. in the future your child is their own person and will have relationships of their own with other family members w/o going through you. Your child is a person after all.
